title: Streaming Chat connector patterns and migration guide for Python SDK
creator: Priya Patel
description: Problem: multiple consumer patterns in the Python SDK (callback hooks, iterator-based, and low-level SSE adapters) have led to repeated user confusion and brittle integrations when applications attempt to add telemetry, retries, or partial-resume. Goal: introduce a connector pattern + migration guide that provides a small, typed consumer facade (ConsumerConnector) and a set of adapter recipes so existing customers can migrate incrementally. The connector must support: resumable checkpoints, typed event signals (message, meta, error, watermark), prioritized soft-retries, and clear telemetry hooks. This ticket covers design, reference implementation, migration docs, and 2 integration examples (FastAPI webhook and a serverless consumer).
acceptance_criteria: Spec: a one-page event contract + connector API published in docs and linked from SDK README
Reference implementation added to python/sdk/connectors with unit tests covering resume/replay and retry semantics
Migration guide with code snippets for callback -> iterator -> connector flows
Two example apps updated: examples/fastapi-chat-consumer and examples/serverless-stream-consumer
Bench: latency regression < 5% for typical 16-token responses in CI microbench compared to current iterator baseline
Telemetry: connector emits token-level counters and persisted resume checkpoints to SDK tracing hooks

implementation_notes: Connector API: class SyncConnector(consumer_callable) and AsyncConnector(async_consumer_callable) with methods: start(), pause(), resume(checkpoint), close()
Event contract: 'type' in {message, meta, error, watermark, checkpoint}; payload schema versioned (v1); include optional 'id' and 'seq' on message events
Retries: connector will expose soft_retry(retry_policy) hook; default policy = exponential backoff with jitter and idempotency by event id
Resume semantics: checkpoint = {cursor, last_seq, model_variant, kv_cache_snapshot_id}; SDK will persist checkpoint to configured storage adapter (in-memory for examples; external store optional)
Telemetry: emit connector.resume, connector.pause, connector.error, connector.message spans; add counters for tokens_emitted and resume_attempts
Migration helpers: callback_to_connector adapter and iterator_to_connector shim provided; examples in the migration guide
Testing: unit tests + integration playback harness that feeds recorded event streams from /tests/fixtures/streams
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: breaking existing integrators who depend on low-level SSE shapes. Mitigation: provide adapter layer and keep old APIs for at least 2 releases with deprecation warnings.
Risk: performance regression from extra event wrapping. Mitigation: microbench target <5% regression; inline event object to reduce allocation pressure.
Risk: incorrect resume leading to duplicate token emissions. Mitigation: add seq-based dedupe in connector and test against recorded streams and race conditions.
